name: go9_se_10ep_rom
hypothesis: 10 epochs per iteration (47% better loss locally) + random opening moves (5.5% better loss, more diverse) on proven SE+GP architecture should significantly outperform se_best (5 epochs).
success_criteria: Loss below 1.2 by iter 200 (se_globalpool was 1.389 at 200 iters with 5 epochs). If loss plateaus above 1.3 for 100+ iters, kill.
notes: REQUIRES: git pull to get random_opening_moves feature. From scratch (no warm start). Expected to be slower per iteration (10 vs 5 epochs) but much more efficient overall. Run after se_best completes.
